Interpretation: The integrated county-year dataset passed completeness and uniqueness checks.
Hazard and loss variables are right-skewed and contain meaningful extremes.
The 80th-percentile rule provides a transparent high-severity classification target.
Socioeconomic variables vary substantially and should be tested through moderation models.
Correlation and VIF tables provide diagnostics for later regression specification.
Annual patterns are exploratory and require formal Mann-Kendall and ARIMA analysis.
The baseline model demonstrates predictive signal but is not a final tuned model.
